image_description: Two small Blenheim spaniel puppies sitting side-by-side on a tan, textured fabric surface (likely a sofa). The puppy on the left is in the foreground, looking slightly to the right, while the puppy on the right is slightly behind, looking forward. Both exhibit characteristic red-and-white markings, large dark eyes, and floppy ears.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Head is domed with short upturned nose and well-defined stop.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Both puppies display the characteristic domed skull shape and short muzzle typical of the breed. The stop is visible, though soft due to puppy features.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Eyes are large, round, dark, and set wide apart.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Eyes are prominent, round, and dark. They appear appropriately spaced for the breed standard.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Ears are long, set low, and heavily feathered with long fringe.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Ears are long and hang low. While 'heavily feathered' is more typical of adults, the puppies show appropriate ear length and setting with some fringe visible.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Rich red-and-white parti-color coat with clearly defined red patches on white ground.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The coat pattern is distinctively Blenheim: white base with clear chestnut/red patches on the ears and head spots. Boundaries are sharp.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Coat is long, silky, and straight with moderate feathering on ears, chest, legs, and tail.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Texture appears soft and slightly wavy/silky. Feathering is present on ears and beginning to show on legs/chest, consistent with puppy development.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Body is compact and cobby with short back of small toy-spaniel proportions.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The bodies appear compact and proportionate to the head size, fitting the 'toy' description.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Legs are straight with fine bone and feathered hindquarters.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Front legs of the left puppy are visible and appear straight. Bone structure looks fine/appropriate for a puppy. Hindquarters are partially obscured but seem proportional.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Tail is docked and carried level with back, well-feathered.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The tails are not clearly visible in this framing; the puppies are sitting such that the rear is obscured or the tail is tucked/hidden behind the body or fabric folds.
The subjects are stationary (sitting), so gait cannot be evaluated.

artifact_observations.location: Puppy on the left, front right paw
artifact_observations.reasoning: The toes on the front right paw of the left puppy blend together slightly, lacking distinct separation between digits. It looks somewhat 'melted' or like a single mass rather than individual toes.

artifact_observations.location: Puppy on the right, rear left leg/paw area
artifact_observations.reasoning: The rear left leg of the right-hand puppy seems to merge indistinctly with the background fabric and the other leg. The paw structure is undefined and appears to dissolve into the surface.
Slight unnatural smoothing/blur in the background fabric folds, typical of AI generation depth-of-field simulation, but not severe.
